description: Universal AgentSam source-kind and file-format identity catalog. Presence in this catalog does not imply that an installed runtime can import, preview, convert or export the format.

sourceKinds.label: Filesystem file
sourceKinds.description: A byte-addressable file on a local or mounted filesystem.

sourceKinds.label: Filesystem directory
sourceKinds.description: A directory whose children may form a native project or multi-file dataset.

sourceKinds.label: Archive entry
sourceKinds.description: A member inside a recognized archive or package.

sourceKinds.label: HTTP resource
sourceKinds.description: A remote resource addressed by URL; content must still be identified.

sourceKinds.label: Cloud object
sourceKinds.description: An object stored by a cloud storage provider.

sourceKinds.label: Provider-managed object
sourceKinds.description: A provider-owned asset or document reference.

sourceKinds.label: Database result
sourceKinds.description: A query result, exported table, or database-native object.

sourceKinds.label: Live stream
sourceKinds.description: A live or time-bounded stream such as camera, audio or video input.

sourceKinds.label: In-memory buffer
sourceKinds.description: Bytes supplied by an application or runtime without a persistent path.

sourceKinds.label: Generated artifact
sourceKinds.description: An output produced by an authorized AgentSam operation or external tool.

sourceKinds.label: Device capture
sourceKinds.description: A capture from an authorized camera, scanner, microphone or other device.

sourceKinds.label: Clipboard payload
sourceKinds.description: A file-like payload supplied through the operating-system clipboard.

sourceKinds.label: Repository blob
sourceKinds.description: A version-controlled object addressed by repository and revision.

sourceKinds.label: Application-native document
sourceKinds.description: A document opened or supplied by an owning application.

sourceKinds.label: Package bundle
sourceKinds.description: A deployable, installable or multi-file application bundle.

sourceKinds.label: Camera capture
sourceKinds.description: A still image, image sequence or video captured from a camera.

sourceKinds.label: Screen capture
sourceKinds.description: A still image or recording captured from a display.

families.label: Structured text, interchange and tabular data
Raster images, photography and image sequences
Reusable 3D geometry sources, assemblies and representations
3D scenes, animation, materials and DCC projects
Reality capture, scan and point-cloud data

signatures.description: RIFF container with WEBP form type

formats.label: OM System / Olympus ORF raw image
MPEG-4 video container
formats.notes: Container identity does not identify the contained video/audio codecs.

formats.label: WebM video container
formats.notes: Container identity does not identify the contained video/audio codecs.

formats.label: InnerAnimalMedia editable IAMScene project
formats.notes: Native editable scene document, identified by format=iamscene and a supported formatVersion. Extension and media type are hints, not proof of parse/edit/export support.

formats.label: InnerAnimalMedia reusable IAMGeometry asset manifest
formats.notes: Versioned reusable geometry manifest linking authoritative source and optional render representations; it is not itself a mesh or BRep kernel.

formats.label: glTF binary model
formats.notes: Binary glTF container; external resources and extensions must still be inspected.

formats.label: STL triangle mesh
formats.notes: Mesh-only representation; not an exact parametric solid.

formats.label: USD zipped scene package
formats.notes: ZIP-derived package with USDZ-specific layout constraints.

formats.label: STEP / ISO 10303 exchange model
formats.notes: Exchange geometry only; AP schema and preserved metadata depend on the importer/exporter.

formats.label: IGES exchange model
formats.notes: Surface and curve exchange; do not assume feature history is preserved.

formats.label: OpenCascade BRep exact geometry
formats.notes: Exact geometric boundary representation; does not by itself encode complete BIM semantics or parametric project history.

formats.label: Industry Foundation Classes model
formats.notes: Schema version and model view definition (MVD) are separate from the .ifc extension.

formats.label: CNC / additive manufacturing G-code
formats.notes: Machine dialect and postprocessor must be resolved separately; extension alone never establishes safe execution.

formats.label: ESRI Shapefile geometry
formats.notes: Multi-file dataset; companion files and common basename must be retained together.

formats.label: ZIP archive
formats.notes: Container identity does not identify the package type or the safety of its contents.

formats.label: OpenTimelineIO compressed timeline archive
formats.notes: Editorial interchange archive; identifying an OTIOZ does not grant video decoding or timeline editing.

formats.label: ODB++ electronics manufacturing package
formats.notes: Directory-based ODB++ job package; it is not a single .odb file. The .odb extension is used by the Abaqus output database.
